Suggested_Matching_Rule: Strip padding; use prefix similarity plus exact security, side, quantity and price
Do not fuzzy-match absence; classify source trade as unmatched / missing at custodian
Map CUSIP to ISIN using security master; compare normalized identifier
Quantity tolerance of +/-1 share when other core economics agree
Price absolute tolerance <= $0.01 with exact security, side and near-exact quantity

Scenario: Side code differs only by letter case
Suggested_Matching_Rule: Upper-case and normalize side code before comparison
Edit-distance <=1 on execution reference plus exact economic fields
Remove spaces and punctuation from reference before comparison

Scenario: One execution split into two custodian settlement records
Suggested_Matching_Rule: Group by order/exec/security/side/price and compare summed quantity to source trade
Fallback weighted match on order reference + security + side + quantity + price
Use edit-distance only when trade economics and account context uniquely support the candidate; otherwise reject

Scenario: Small price variance combined with exact trade economics
Suggested_Matching_Rule: Price tolerance <= $0.01; require exact normalized security, side and quantity
